scripts.dev: concurrently -n FE,BE,ML -c cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ml
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
